intro: See how your class is doing in Git Quest. Import the progress files your students send you.
footer: Students download their progress file from the game (Export progress) and send it to you, for example as an assignment upload in your learning platform.

privacy.title: Your students' data stays here.
privacy.body: Files are read inside this browser. Nothing is uploaded to any server. A file holds only a display name, a class code and level results.

import.title: Import progress files
import.dropHint: Drag and drop .gitquest.json files here, or choose them from your computer.
import.help: You can select many files at once. If a student sends two files, the newest one is kept.
import.clearConfirm_other: Remove all {{count}} students from this dashboard?
import.remember: Remember the imported class in this browser
import.saveFailed: This browser could not store the class (it may be full or blocked). The dashboard still works, but you will need to import the files again next time.

notice.olderSkipped: Skipped. A newer file for {{name}} is already loaded.
notice.duplicateSkipped: Skipped. This file for {{name}} is already loaded.
notice.checksum: This file for {{name}} was changed after it was exported. The numbers may not be real. Check with the student.
notice.sampleRemoved_one: Removed {{count}} demo student because you imported real files.
notice.sampleRemoved_other: Removed {{count}} demo students because you imported real files.

importError.empty: This file is empty. Ask the student to export their progress again.
importError.tooLarge: This file is too big to be a Git Quest progress file.
importError.unreadable: This file could not be read. Try saving it again, then import it.
importError.notJson: This is not a Git Quest progress file. Progress files end in .gitquest.json.
importError.notProgress: This is not a Git Quest progress file. Progress files end in .gitquest.json.
importError.newerVersion: This file comes from a newer version of Git Quest (format {{version}}). Open the newest version of the game and try again.
importError.olderVersion: This file comes from an old version of Git Quest (format {{version}}) that is no longer supported.
importError.damaged: This Git Quest file is damaged (problem at "{{detail}}"). Ask the student to export it again.

sample.banner: You are looking at demo students. Import your class's files to replace them, or press Clear all.

empty.title: No students yet
empty.body: Import your students' progress files above, or load the sample class to see what the dashboard shows.

csv.help: The CSV files contain the students shown above. They open in Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice.
csv.name: Name
csv.title: Title
csv.hint3Percent: Opened hint 3 (% of students who started)

table.sortHint: Select a column heading to sort. Select a name to see every level.
table.name: Name

checksum.okHelp: The file has not been changed since the student exported it.
checksum.mismatchHelp: The file was changed after it was exported, so the numbers may not be real. Ask the student to export again.
checksum.missingHelp: The file has no checksum, so the dashboard cannot tell whether it was changed.

stuck.attentionIntro: Hint 3 shows the exact command. When many students open it, the level may need a class discussion or a rewrite.
stuck.noHintData: No student has opened hint 3 yet.
stuck.sentence: {{percent}}% of students opened hint 3 on level {{level}} ({{title}}).
stuck.flaggedSummary_one: {{count}} level is marked "High hint use" (half or more of the students who tried it opened hint 3).
stuck.flaggedSummary_other: {{count}} levels are marked "High hint use" (half or more of the students who tried them opened hint 3).
stuck.showUnstarted: Also show levels nobody has started
stuck.captionHelp: Times and hint rates count only the students who started each level. Select a column heading to sort.
stuck.noRows: No student has started a level yet.
